name: flowcore
description: Root orchestration scripts for the FlowCore monorepo.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.audit: npm --prefix frontend audit --omit=dev && docker compose exec -T backend composer audit
scripts.fitness: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run audit
scripts.guard:migrations: docker compose exec -T backend php artisan migrate:status --no-interaction
